paite: Paikan Ankuanglui kipat ma in, Jesu'n hiai khovel nusia a Pa kiang a apai hun hong tungta chih athei a; khovel a a-itte, atawp pha in a-it hi.
heading: Jesu'n Nungzuite Khe Asil

paite: Huan nitak an nek lai a, diabol in Simon tapa, Judas Iskariot, lungtang a Jesu zuausan a matsak lungsim akoihsak khit nung in,
Pa'n akhut ah thil bangkim apeta chih leh Pathian a kipan hong pai ahi a, Pathian kiang a pai ding ahi chih, Jesu'n theigige in,
nitak an um lai adingh a, apuante asuahkhia a, kinulna puan ala a, ateng hi.
Huan kisilna kuang ah tui asung a, nungzuite khe asilsak a, akinulna puanten in anul zel hi.
Huchi in Simon Peter kiang ah ahong a, "Toupa, nang tel in ka khe na sil dia hia?" achi hi.
Jesu'n akiang ah, "Ka thilhih tu'n ah na thei kei; himahleh tunung chiang in na thei ding," chi in adawng hi.
Peter in akiang ah, "Ka khe na sil kei hial ding," achi hi. Jesu'n akiang ah, "Na khe ka sil keileh ka kiang ah tan na nei kei ding," achi hi.
Simon Peter in akiang ah, "Toupa, ka khe kia hilou in, ka khutte leh ka lutang leng aw," achi hi.
Jesu'n akiang ah, "Kisil khinsa akhe lou ngal sil akiphamoh kei, apumpi in asiang; nou na siang uh, na vek un zaw ahi kei," achi hi.
Amansak dingpa athei ngal a; huaiziak in, "Na vek un zaw na siang kei uh," achi hi.
Huchi in akhete uh asil khit a, apuante alak a, atut nawn in akiang uah, "Na tung ua ka thilhih na thei uhia?" achi hi.
"Nou, Toupa leh heutupa na hon chi ua; na chi dik uh, ka hihna mah ahi.
Kei Toupa leh na heutupa un na khe uh ka silleh noute'n leng na khe uh na kisilsak chiat ding uh ahi.
Na tung ua ka hih bang in, nou leng na hih sam ding un, hihdan ding hon hilh ka hi.
Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, sikha apu sang in athupizaw kei a; sawl a om leng asawlpa sang in athupizaw sam kei hi.
Huai thilte na theih ua, na hih uleh minuamsa na hi uhi.
"Na vek ua thu ka gen kei a; ka telte ka thei; himahleh ka tanghou nepa'n ka tung ah akhetul alikta chih, Laisiangthou ahong tuntheihna ding ahi.
Tu in ahong tun ma in ka hon hilh ahi, ahong tun hun chiang a kei amah ka hi chih na gintakna ding un.
Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, kuapeuh ka sawl kipahpih, kei hon kipahpih ahi; kuapeuh kei hon kipahpih, hon sawlpa kipahpih ahi," achi hi.
Jesu'n huai thu agen khit in, alungsim amangbang a, "Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, na lak ua mi khat in kei hon mansak ding," chi in atheisakta hi.
heading: Jesu'n Matsak A A-om Ding Agenkhol

paite: Huan nungzuite'n achih pen athei kei ua, aki-entuah chiat uhi.
Anungzuite lak a khat, Jesu'n a-itpa, dohkan sik ah Jesu angsung ah kingai in a-om hi.
Simon Peter in huai mi kiang ah, kua pen thu ahia agen dong ding in akhutvan hi.
Jesu awm ngai mah in a-awnphei a, akiang ah, "Toupa, kua pen ahia?" achi hi.
Jesu'n, "Tanghou them ka diah a, ka piakpa ahi ding," chi in adawng hi. Huchi in tanghou them adiah zoh in Simon tapa, Judas Iskariot in kiang ah apia hi.
Tanghou them apiak nung in asung ah Setan alutta hi. Huchi in Jesu'n akiang ah, "Na hih ding hih meng in," achi hi.
Dohkan a omte'n bang tum a hiai thu gen hiam chih athei kei uh.
Akhen in Judas in dangka ip akep ziak in, Jesu'n ankuangluina a ding thil kiphamoh peuh lei in, chi hiam, migentheite kiang ah banghiam piak ding, chi hiam asa uhi.
Huan tanghou them la in, apawtkhe pah a; huai tuh zan lai ahi.
Huaiziak in apawt nung in, Jesu'n agen a, "Tu in Mihing Tapa pahtawi in a-omta a, Pathian leng amah ziak in pahtawi in a-om hi.
heading: Thupiak Thak

paite: Amah a Pathian pahtawi a a-omleh amah leng Pathian mahmah in apahtawi ding a, apahtawi pahta ding hi.

Naute aw, hun tomchik na kiang uah ka om lai tadih hi. Nou na hon zong ding uh; Judate kiang a, ka paina ding ah nou na hong pai thei kei ding uh chih ka gen bang in, tu in huchi mah bang in na kiang uah ka gen ahi.
Thupiak thak ka hon pia ahi, ki-ittuah chiat un; ke'n nou ka hon it bang in, nou leng ki-ittuah un.
Na ki-ittuah uleh mi tengteng in ka nungzuite na hi uh chih hiai ah athei ding uh," achi hi.
Simon Peter in akiang ah, "Toupa, koi a hoh ding na hia? achi hi. Jesu'n, ka hohna ding ah nang tu in na hon zui thei kei ding; tunung chiang in zaw na hon zui ding," chi in adawng hi.
heading: Peter Kitheihmohbawl Ding Genkholhna / (Mat 26.31-35; Mar 14.27-31; Luk 22.31-34)

paite: Peter in akiang ah, "Toupa, bang ding in ahia tua leng ka hon zuih theih louh ding? Nangmah ziak in ka hinna ka koihkhe ding," achi hi.
Jesu'n, "Keimah ziak in na hinna na koihkhe ding maw? Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, nang thumvei na hon kitheihmohbawl ma in ak akhuang kei ding," chi in adawng hi.
